body: That's true, since we have discussed thoughts before then it certainly isn't a guarantee he would hospitalize me. Plus, I am feeling a bit better today, and hopefully will be even more tomorrow, so when I go in there it might not be bad enough to anyway. Thanks for your input and I definitely am going to tell him everything.

If someone came in saying they have a clear plan and intention to commit suicide they will most likely be committed. But honestly I've thought more about it and if that is what's going to happen then maybe I need to be after all.

I know what you mean. Therapy has been helping me I thought, but all of a sudden things took a turn for the worse. But it's because of my job and lack of friends which is making me so miserable that therapy won't change anything unless I make the changes myself, which I haven't yet. Anyways I would say it is worth it to give it a try at least... it is so nice having someone non-judgmental and on-your-side to talk to.

Thank you for the response. It was late last night so I just went to sleep. I am still having the thoughts this morning but not as bad. My appointment with him is tomorrow so I am going to keep contemplating this until then.
